timeline.text: One old phone on a shelf kept the camera and stick guard alive — a dropped Wi-Fi handshake and nobody noticed until dark.
Like running security on someone's personal cellphone — one dead battery and it's dark.
Now a small Python script runs as a background service on the home PC itself, restarting automatically after every reboot.
Camera feed, stick guard, PTZ, and tunnel access — all four services now survive a reboot without anyone touching a phone.
